name: FRP Security Cabin
description:
FRP security cabins are compact guard units built on a steel frame and clad with FRP — fibre-reinforced plastic — panels, designed to stand at a gate or checkpoint and shrug off sun, rain and daily knocks with very little upkeep. SAMAN POS India Private Limited manufactures FRP security cabins as an NSIC-registered OEM: the Government of India's National Small Industries Corporation lists "FRP Security Cabin" by name on our Government Purchase Enlistment (Ref. NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), so you are buying direct from the maker, not a reseller.

What "FRP" means in a SAMAN security cabin

FRP stands for fibre-reinforced plastic — a polymer matrix reinforced with fibres that forms a tough, weatherproof skin. In our build it is not a flimsy moulded shell: the cabin has a structural steel frame underneath, with FRP and cement-board panels forming the walls. That combination gives you the rigidity of steel and the corrosion-free, low-maintenance surface of FRP in one unit. Per our NSIC store record, the materials are steel to IS 2062 Grade A and IS 1079 Grade O, cement board to IS 14862:2000 and IS 14871:2000, an FRP polymer matrix with reinforcing fibres to IS 456:2000, and protective paints to IS 1200-15, IS 2395-1 and IS 1477-2.

Sizes we manufacture

The standard FRP security cabin is a 6 × 6 × 7 ft unit — a comfortable one-guard footprint. The following sizes are all listed under our NSIC enlistment, so each is a configuration we are registered to supply:

Size (ft)FootprintTypical use
6 × 6 × 7Standard one-guard cabinFactory and society main gates
6 × 8 × 7Larger — desk plus storageBusy gates, two-shift posts
5 × 5 × 7CompactTight gateways, kiosks
6 × 4 × 7Slim single-occupantToll booths, narrow entries

Heights are 7 ft across the range. If your post needs a footprint between these, tell us the gate width and the number of guards and we will confirm what we can build.

Where an FRP security cabin works best

  • Factory and warehouse gates — a weatherproof post for the guard controlling vehicle and visitor entry, sited at the boundary without civil work.
  • Apartment and society gates — a clean, low-maintenance cabin for the gate guard that looks tidy at a residential entrance and resists rust through the monsoon.
  • Toll booths and narrow entries — the slim 6 × 4 × 7 ft unit fits a single attendant beside a lane where space is tight.

How it is built, and why factory-direct matters

Each cabin is fabricated in our own factory: the steel frame is cut and welded, the FRP and cement-board panels are fixed, and the unit is painted and quality-checked before dispatch — it arrives ready to place, not assembled on your site. Our FRP security cabin range was inspected by SGS India (Inspection Report IN/BGL/NSIC/239/2025) as part of the NSIC enlistment, and we are registered to supply this item as an OEM. Because we manufacture in-house, you deal with the maker on price, specification and lead time.

Frequently asked questions

Is an FRP security cabin all plastic, or does it have a steel frame?

It has a steel frame. The structure is steel (IS 2062 / IS 1079); the FRP and cement board form the wall panels. You get steel rigidity with a corrosion-free, low-maintenance outer surface — not a moulded plastic box.

What sizes can I order?

Our NSIC-listed FRP security cabins are 6 × 6 × 7 ft (standard), 6 × 8 × 7 ft, 5 × 5 × 7 ft and 6 × 4 × 7 ft. Share your gate width and guard count and we will confirm the right size.

Is SAMAN actually registered to make FRP security cabins?

Yes. "FRP Security Cabin" is listed by name on our NSIC Government Purchase Enlistment (Ref. NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), with the unit inspected by SGS India. We supply it as an OEM manufacturer.

Does it need a foundation or civil work?

No civil construction is required. The cabin is a self-contained unit that is placed on a firm, level surface at your gate; it can be relocated later if your layout changes.

What warranty comes with the cabin?

SAMAN cabins carry our standard cover: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.

Get a quote for an FRP security cabin

Tell us the size, the gate it will stand at and how many guards it must seat, and we will share availability and a price. Explore the full security cabin range to compare options.

Call +91 88616 22859

Certifications and Manufacturer Credentials

SAMAN POS India Private Limited (POS = Portable Office Solutions) has manufactured portable and modular units since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered across India from our plants at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 and Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, Gautam Budh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201308). Director: Md Monazir Alam. Certifications and registrations: ISO 9001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218646), ISO 45001:2018 (Cert No. E20250218647), NSIC Government Purchase Enlistment (Ref. NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207, valid 24/03/2025–23/03/2027), DPIIT-recognised startup (Ref. DIPP56005), Udyam registered (UDYAM-KR-03-0172770), GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR (Bangalore) and 09ABBCS7101B1ZT (Noida). Structural steel to IS 2062.
